name: 武林列传Ⅲ
english_name: Wulin Liezhuan III (Chronicles of the Martial World III)
english_description: 武林列传Ⅲ, a Chinese wuxia MUD from the 侠客行 (Xiake Xing) family, last run in 2008-2009. Its world spans about sixty regions, from the Shaolin, Wudang, Emei, Huashan and Mingjiao sect grounds to cities such as Yangzhou, Hangzhou, Quanzhou and Xiangyang and outlying places like Xiakedao island and the Xingxiu desert. The surviving release ships most of its game code only in compiled MudOS form.
